title: Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan Publishes Scrutinized Lists for Lecturer Positions Advertised Under Nos. 62 (2025) and 65 (2025)
labels: Notification From Office of The Registrar
text:
Official Notice – Scrutinized Lists for Lecturer Positions

Advertised under Advertisement No. 62 (2025) dated September 6, 2025

and Advertisement No. 65 (2025) dated December 2, 2025

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan

All applications received through the University’s online recruitment portal by the prescribed closing dates were thoroughly scrutinized by the Scrutiny & Quantification Committee in accordance with the relevant statutes, rules, and advertised eligibility criteria.

The scrutinized lists are now available on the official recruitment portal:

View Scrutinized Lists (https://jobs.awkum.edu.pk/open-posts)

Applicants are advised to visit the link and check their status. In case of any appeal, candidates may submit the same through the portal within the notified timeline using their existing login credentials.

For further information, please contact the Office of the Registrar.

Registrar
Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan
